decisions.reason: This carrier wafer is an incremental extension of the core wafer-handling business and fits the firm's capabilities and search direction, so without clear evidence that results fell below aspiration levels it would be kept.

As a flagship interposer product closely tied to the firm's R&D-based strategic direction, management would usually grant it time and organizational slack to prove itself unless performance clearly disappointed.
The off-the-shelf wafer brand is very close to the established business and helps commercialize standard products more efficiently, so it is likely to remain unless sales are unexpectedly weak.

Glass-based circuit boards are the most distant from the firm's established substrate business, so if outcomes are uncertain or below aspiration the firm would reallocate resources to better-aligned core and development projects.
